title: Mobile-first checkout flow
prompt: Build the checkout flow for our shop: cart review, shipping address, payment method, confirmation. Mobile-first, React. Conversion matters; don't get creative with the flow.

must: Convention respected (the brief wins; Jakob at maximum); standing-exit register
Forms follow the full contract: labels, autocomplete, inputmode, paste allowed, errors inline with focus management
Touch targets >= 44px; 16px+ input font (iOS zoom); safe areas respected
In-flight submit protection (disabled + progress + idempotency note)
must_not: Novel checkout patterns the user explicitly declined
Decorative animation in the payment path
